sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN YearlyIncome < 30000 THEN '1. <30K'
    WHEN YearlyIncome < 60000 THEN '2. 30K-60K'
    WHEN YearlyIncome < 90000 THEN '3. 60K-90K'
    WHEN YearlyIncome < 120000 THEN '4. 90K-120K'
    WHEN YearlyIncome >= 120000 THEN '5. 120K+'
    ELSE '6. Unknown'
  END AS IncomeBracket,
  count(DISTINCT c.CustomerKey) AS CustomerCount,
  round(sum(o.SalesAmount), 2) AS TotalSpend,
  round(sum(o.SalesAmount) / count(DISTINCT c.CustomerKey), 2) AS AvgSpendPerCustomer,
  round(avg(c.YearlyIncome), 2) AS AvgYearlyIncome,
  round(corr(c.YearlyIncome, o.SalesAmount), 4) AS IncomeSpendCorrelation
FROM retail.DimCustomer c
INNER JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales o ON o.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
GROUP BY IncomeBracket
ORDER BY IncomeBracket;
